# ferentin_mcp_policies (Data Source)

List every MCP policy in the tenant, remote and local, sorted by priority then name. Includes `report_only` policies and the `<name> · local` rehearsal siblings the platform split off (`sibling_of` set).

Every item carries `import_id`, the ID its resource's `import` block takes, and `managed_by`, who created it (`console`, `iac`, …). Filter on `managed_by = "console"` to find what Terraform does not manage yet.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every MCP policy in the tenant, remote and local, by priority then name.
data "ferentin_mcp_policies" "all" {}

# Policies that only record what they would decide.
output "rehearsing" {
  value = [for p in data.ferentin_mcp_policies.all.policies : p.name if p.mode == "report_only"]
}

# Policies created in the console, with the import ID each one takes.
output "console_policies" {
  value = { for p in data.ferentin_mcp_policies.all.policies : p.name => p.import_id if p.managed_by == "console" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant to list. Defaults to the provider's.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `applies_at` (String) `admit`, `call` or `both`.
- `effect` (String) The effect type: `allow`, `deny` or `step_up`.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `import_id` (String) `<tenant_id>/<policy_id>`, for an `import` block.
- `last_modified_by` (String) Who wrote it last. Divergence from `managed_by` means it changed hands.
- `managed_by` (String) Who created it: `console`, `iac`, `cli`, `system` or `unknown`. Never changes.
- `mode` (String) `enforce` or `report_only`.
- `name` (String)
- `policy_id` (String)
- `priority` (Number)
- `provider_instances` (List of String) MCP server UUIDs the policy names. Empty when it names device targets only.
- `sibling_of` (String) Set on a `<name> · local` rehearsal policy: the policy it was split from.
- `target_kinds` (List of String) The kinds of the device targets the policy names, in stored order. Empty when it names none.
